turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like the perfect way to wake up before a long night. How is everything else going today? Have you and Tom been up to much?

turns.text: Simple and healthy, that works! I hope the cafeteria has some good toppings tonight. Well, I hope your shift is relatively calm and goes smoothly.

turns.speaker: user
